product.name: 黄麻楼梯踏板 15 片
product.title: 15PC Jute Stair Treads for Wooden Steps - Non Slip Peel and Stick Stair Treads Indoor, 8"x30" Beige
product.bsr: Staircase Step Treads 第 34 名

summary: 最大的问题是边角翘、粘不住：34 条里有 12 条在说，而且其中 10 条来自 4–5 星好评，用户自己另买胶带补救。买的人主要是家里有狗、怕狗在木楼梯上打滑。
insight: 只看差评会漏掉它：1–2 星的差评原因很分散（伤地板、不能洗、收到二手货各 1 条），真正最多的「粘不住」，10 条藏在 4–5 星里。

problems.name: 边角翘、粘不住
problems.fix: 四角加强背胶，或把随货胶带从一小卷加到够每片四角用；页面和安装卡写明「四角加贴随附胶带」
quotes: Don't buy, waste of money. They do not stick. I have cleaned wiped everything correctly as I've done before but they have literally peel up on the corners. Also having a very hard time getting the creases out.
别买，浪费钱。按以前的方法清洁过，四角还是一直翘起来；折痕也很难弄平。

Quality is not good, thin. You have to fight to get the plastic off the back and then the product is supposed to be self stick, what a joke, it is not sticky at all. Not safe to use without buying carpet tape.
质量不好、偏薄。背面塑料膜要跟它较劲才撕得下来，号称自粘，其实一点都不粘，不另买地毯胶带不安全。
2★ · 款式未标
These are nice, feel good too, just wish the adhesive went all the way to corners. Corners lift up, little stronger adhesive would of done the trick.
不错，脚感也好，希望背胶贴到四角。四角会翘，胶再强一点就好了。

problems.name: 背膜难撕
problems.fix: 背膜改成两段预切口；安装卡写上用户自己摸索出的方法：从中缝往两边撕，或先用美工刀沿边划一圈
quotes: These look great and are generally easily to install with some effort. Peeling the back can be challenging. Also, since they arrive folded, it can be hard to get the crease out of the middle. They don't stick on perfectly, but overall very happy with them.
看着很好，费点劲能装好。背膜难撕；折着发货，中间折痕难弄平；粘得不完全牢，但总体满意。

Film is easy to peel, however there's a certain way to pull or it is easy to rip and then it's miserable trying to take off the film. Corners loft up slightly but they do give you a roll of tape. They feel great, they look great.
膜要按对方向撕，不然容易撕破，残膜很难抠。四角有点翘，盒里给了一卷胶带。脚感和样子都好。

problems.name: 运输折痕
problems.fix: 改成卷装或平装发货，31×31 落地垫优先
quotes: These look great and are generally easily to install with some effort. Peeling the back can be challenging. Also, since they arrive folded, it can be hard to get the crease out of the middle. They don't stick on perfectly, but overall very happy with them.
看着很好，费点劲能装好。背膜难撕；折着发货，中间折痕难弄平；粘得不完全牢，但总体满意。

Don't buy, waste of money. They do not stick. I have cleaned wiped everything correctly as I've done before but they have literally peel up on the corners. Also having a very hard time getting the creases out.
别买，浪费钱。按以前的方法清洁过，四角还是一直翘起来；折痕也很难弄平。

problems.name: 不耐用、偏薄
quotes: Quality is not good, thin. You have to fight to get the plastic off the back and then the product is supposed to be self stick, what a joke, it is not sticky at all. Not safe to use without buying carpet tape.
质量不好、偏薄。背面塑料膜要跟它较劲才撕得下来，号称自粘，其实一点都不粘，不另买地毯胶带不安全。
2★ · 款式未标

problems.name: 伤地板
problems.fix: 只有 1 条，但和「无残胶」卖点冲突，要查是哪种地板
quotes: Works well and easy to install, not cheap but I wanted natural materials. Just hoping the self adhesive doesn't damage the floor. Follow up: unfortunately, a week later it already hurt the floor.
好装，想要天然材质才买的，就怕背胶伤地板。追评：一周后地板已经被伤了。

problems.name: 收到二手货
problems.fix: 只有 1 条，查 FBA 退货有没有被当新品重新上架
quotes: The mats themselves are pretty nice, but half of the mats in my order came with the backing already peeled off and dirty. You'll be getting someone's half-used return.
垫子本身不错，但一半背膜已经撕开还脏了。收到的是别人用过退回的货。

problems.name: 尺寸偏小
problems.fix: 页面写清 8"×30" 适合多宽的台阶
quotes: I was really hopeful for these as a temporary fix to installing a professional runner. They are much too small for our builder grade stairs. Will be returning.
本想用来临时替代定制地毯，但对我家标准楼梯来说太小了，准备退货。

problems.name: 不能洗
problems.fix: 五点里写了，但还有人没看到；主图标出「只能吸尘或湿布擦」
quotes: These look very nice but they are NOT washable. So, with kids and pets, this product is not the best product.
好看但不能洗。家里有孩子和宠物就不合适。

praises.name: 好看，像定制的
praises.use: 主图和标题：「像定制楼梯地毯」
quotes: These look great and are generally easily to install with some effort. Peeling the back can be challenging. Also, since they arrive folded, it can be hard to get the crease out of the middle. They don't stick on perfectly, but overall very happy with them.
看着很好，费点劲能装好。背膜难撕；折着发货，中间折痕难弄平；粘得不完全牢，但总体满意。
Guests commented on how this looks like a custom installation. We previously had quoted a custom runner which would have cost 10x the price. I used some tools to improve the installation method.
客人以为是定制安装的，之前定制楼梯地毯的报价是它的 10 倍。我用了些工具让安装更顺。

praises.name: 狗不再在楼梯上打滑
praises.use: 主图放狗上下楼的场景，尤其是老年犬
quotes: Easy to install and actually has worked a lot better than the clear plastic stick-ons. These have really helped my elderly large dog. Has made the wooden stairs so QUIET now for everyone.
好装，比透明塑料防滑条好用多了，帮了我家的老年大狗。木楼梯一下变得很安静。
I bought one piece for the bottom step. I have an older dog and I didn't want him slipping on the last step. The adhesive has held up well, it's been there for months.
买了一片放在最下面一级，怕老狗在最后一级打滑。贴了几个月，背胶一直没问题。

reviews.en: These worked great. I read reviews of others and got more carpet tape to take down.

reviews.en: We purchased these after our dog slipped and fell down our wooden stairs, and they've made a huge difference. The jute material looks much nicer than I expected. Our dog seems much more confident going up and down the stairs now.
reviews.zh: 狗在木楼梯上摔过之后买的，效果很明显。黄麻比预期好看，狗上下楼自信多了。

reviews.en: Good quality, easy installation. I do recommend these.
reviews.zh: 质量好，好装，推荐。

reviews.en: Film is easy to peel, however there's a certain way to pull or it is easy to rip and then it's miserable trying to take off the film. Corners loft up slightly but they do give you a roll of tape. They feel great, they look great.
reviews.zh: 膜要按对方向撕，不然容易撕破，残膜很难抠。四角有点翘，盒里给了一卷胶带。脚感和样子都好。

reviews.en: The plastic backing absolutely sucks to take off. The best way is to tear it down the middle and pull from the middle to the sides. These stair treads are not sticky enough on their own to effectively stay down. In the box was a small roll of adhesive tape. You will need it. There is not enough extra tape to do a strip along each edge.
reviews.zh: 背膜真的难撕，要从中间撕开往两边拉。自己粘不牢，盒里那一小卷胶带一定要用，每个角贴一点；不够每条边都贴，多给一卷就好了。

reviews.en: These look very nice but they are NOT washable. So, with kids and pets, this product is not the best product.
reviews.zh: 好看但不能洗。家里有孩子和宠物就不合适。

reviews.en: Our dog was scared to death and slipped and fell a lot. These worked out great. Took a couple of weeks to get the crease out of them because they were shipped folded in half. Might want to consider shipping flat.
reviews.zh: 狗之前怕得要命、老摔，现在没问题了。折着发货，折痕两周才平，建议平着寄。

reviews.en: The mats themselves are pretty nice, but half of the mats in my order came with the backing already peeled off and dirty. You'll be getting someone's half-used return.
reviews.zh: 垫子本身不错，但一半背膜已经撕开还脏了。收到的是别人用过退回的货。

reviews.en: It took about 15 minutes to take the backing off. I was fearful that the stickiness wouldn't keep the tread in place. However it's stuck on firmly. I installed these to prevent my 90lb Labrador from slipping down the staircase.
reviews.zh: 撕背膜花了 15 分钟。本来担心粘不住，结果很牢。为了 90 磅的拉布拉多不再滑下楼梯买的。

reviews.en: Fits well and looks really nice. May need some additional glue.

reviews.en: These are great! I did buy extra adhesive tape to install but they stay in place and look great!

reviews.en: Very nice
